import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

models = data['model_benchmarks']['data']
dimensions = data['model_benchmarks']['dimensions']

# Family colors (specified in task)
family_colors = {
    'GPT': '#2563EB',      # blue
    'Claude': '#7C3AED',   # purple
    'Gemini': '#16A34A',   # green
    'LLaMA': '#EA580C',    # orange
    'Qwen': '#DC2626',     # red
}

# Flagship models get thicker/brighter lines
flagship_models = {'GPT-4o', 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet', 'Gemini 1.5 Pro', 'LLaMA 3.1 405B', 'Qwen2.5 72B'}

# Lighter versions for lightweight variants
family_colors_light = {
    'GPT': '#93C5FD',
    'Claude': '#C4B5FD',
    'Gemini': '#86EFAC',
    'LLaMA': '#FDBA74',
    'Qwen': '#FCA5A5',
}

# Short dimension labels for axis display
dim_labels = [
    'Reasoning',
    'Code\nGeneration',
    'Math /\nQuantitative',
    'Language\nUnderstanding',
    'Multimodal\nUnderstanding',
    'Instruction\nFollowing',
    'Inference\nSpeed',
    'Knowledge\nRecall',
]

# Set up figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 10), dpi=150)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAF9')
ax.set_facecolor('#FAFAF9')

# Axis positions
x_positions = np.arange(len(dimensions))

# Draw vertical axes
for i, dim in enumerate(dimensions):
    ax.axvline(x=i, color='#D1D5DB', linewidth=1.0, linestyle='-', zorder=1)
    # Axis tick marks for scale
    for val in [0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100]:
        ax.plot(i, val, '_', color='#9CA3AF', markersize=4, zorder=2)

# Axis labels
ax.set_xticks(x_positions)
ax.set_xticklabels(dim_labels, fontsize=10, fontweight=500, color='#374151', ha='center')
ax.set_ylim(-5, 108)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(dimensions) - 0.5)

# Y-axis
ax.set_ylabel('Normalized Score (0–100)', fontsize=12, fontweight=600, color='#374151', labelpad=12)
ax.yaxis.set_ticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(labelsize=9, colors='#6B7280')

# Spines and grid
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_color('#D1D5DB')
ax.yaxis.grid(True, color='#E5E7EB', linewidth=0.5, linestyle='--', zorder=0)

# Sort models: draw lightweight first (behind), then flagship (on top)
sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m['model'] in flagship_models, m['model']))

# Draw polylines for each model
for model_data in sorted_models:
    model_name = model_data['model']
    family = model_data['family']
    is_flagship = model_name in flagship_models

    # Get scores for each dimension
    scores = [model_data[dim] for dim in dimensions]

    if is_flagship:
        color = family_colors[family]
        lw = 2.8
        alpha = 0.95
        zorder = 10
        marker_size = 6
    else:
        color = family_colors_light[family]
        lw = 1.4
        alpha = 0.7
        zorder = 5
        marker_size = 3

    ax.plot(x_positions, scores, color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha,
            zorder=zorder, solid_capstyle='round', solid_joinstyle='round')
    ax.scatter(x_positions, scores, color=color, s=marker_size**2, alpha=alpha,
               zorder=zorder + 1, edgecolors='none')

# Add model name labels at the rightmost axis (Knowledge Recall)
for model_data in models:
    model_name = model_data['model']
    family = model_data['family']
    is_flagship = model_name in flagship_models
    last_score = model_data[dimensions[-1]]

    color = family_colors[family] if is_flagship else family_colors_light[family]
    fontweight = 600 if is_flagship else 400
    fontsize = 8.5 if is_flagship else 7.5
    alpha = 0.95 if is_flagship else 0.7

    # Offset to avoid overlap
    ax.annotate(model_name, xy=(len(dimensions) - 1, last_score),
                xytext=(8, 0), textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=fontweight, color=color,
                alpha=alpha, va='center', ha='left',
                annotation_clip=True)

# Highlight trade-off regions with subtle background shading

# Reasoning ↔ Inference Speed crossing zone
# These are axes 0 and 6
# Add subtle annotation arrows
ax.annotate('', xy=(6, 85), xytext=(0, 85),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#9CA3AF', lw=1.2,
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15', linestyle='--'))
ax.text(3, 95, 'Reasoning ↔ Speed\nTrade-off',
        fontsize=9, fontweight=600, color='#6B7280', ha='center', va='center',
        style='italic', alpha=0.8)

# Multimodal ↔ Math divergence zone
# These are axes 2 and 4
ax.annotate('', xy=(4, 50), xytext=(2, 50),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#9CA3AF', lw=1.2,
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15', linestyle='--'))
ax.text(3, 44, 'Multimodal ↔ Math\nDivergence',
        fontsize=9, fontweight=600, color='#6B7280', ha='center', va='center',
        style='italic', alpha=0.8)

# Title
fig.suptitle('AI Model Capability Benchmarks — Parallel Coordinates',
             fontsize=20, fontweight=700, color='#111827', y=0.97,
             fontstyle='normal')
ax.set_title('Each line represents a model; color indicates family. Thicker lines = flagship models.',
             fontsize=11, fontweight=400, color='#6B7280', pad=14)

# Legend
legend_handles = []
for family in ['GPT', 'Claude', 'Gemini', 'LLaMA', 'Qwen']:
    # Flagship
    h1 = mpatches.Patch(color=family_colors[family], label=f'{family} (flagship)')
    # Lightweight
    h2 = mpatches.Patch(color=family_colors_light[family], label=f'{family} (lightweight)', alpha=0.7)
    legend_handles.extend([h1, h2])

legend = ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper center',
                   bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.10), ncol=5,
                   fontsize=9, frameon=True, fancybox=True,
                   edgecolor='#D1D5DB', facecolor='#F9FAFB',
                   handlelength=1.5, handleheight=1.2,
                   columnspacing=1.5, title='Model Family',
                   title_fontsize=10)
legend.get_title().set_fontweight(600)
legend.get_title().set_color('#374151')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.08, 1, 0.95])

# Save
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none',
            pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
